resources.string: Course 3 · Advanced. 18 holes in the autumn highlands: golden grass, pines, rocks and cold lakes. Greens lie beyond narrow attack routes: successful driver and wood carries can save a shot. Broad detours offer safer landings but need an extra shot. On par 3s, short bailouts allow a two-shot route to the green.

string-array.name: classic_wild_tips
string-array.item: The green lies beyond the narrow clearing. A precise driver to the 232 m landing leaves about 150 m. The broad outside fairway leaves over 280 m and needs an extra setup shot.
Driver to the 225 m pocket, then wood 3 for 205 m to the final bank: about 117 m remain. The broad outside shelves skirt the lakes in four shots before putting.
Attack the small green beyond the lake to arrive in one shot. The broad short bailout on the dry bank avoids the direct crossing but leaves a chip of about 68 m. Watch the rear sand.

The green sits just beyond the narrow left passage when viewed from the tee. A precise driver to the 227 m landing leaves about 193 m. The broad right detour leaves over 310 m: play a setup shot, then approach.
The green extends the narrow cape. A driver to the 229 m landing beyond the lake leaves about 154 m. The broad opposite shelf leaves about 299 m and needs an extra approach shot.
Driver to the first stone at 220 m, then wood 3 for 211 m to the second bank: about 125 m remain. The broad outside bank avoids the small targets but needs four shots to the green.
Attack the small green directly with a long club beyond the bunker. The broad short apron is an easier target but leaves about 87 m. Read the climb in the preview.
Carry the quarry to the narrow tongue at 227 m: the green lies about 183 m further along that side. The broad outside fairway leaves over 310 m and needs an extra shot.
The narrow 226 m landing cuts the pine S and leaves about 209 m to the green. The broad opposite shelf leaves about 329 m: play a setup shot before approaching.
The descent adds carry: control the driver to the small 228 m landing. The green lies on the same side, about 141 m away. The broad opposite bank leaves about 287 m and needs an extra shot.
A precise driver to the 232 m clearing opens about 212 m to the green beyond the narrow route. The broad detour across the woodland leaves over 335 m and needs an extra approach shot.
The narrow green lies beyond the lake with rear sand. Attack directly to arrive in one, or choose the broad dry-bank bailout, leaving about 76 m to play.

Driver to the narrow tongue at 229 m leaves about 139 m. Wood 3 to the central 210 m pocket leaves about 178 m with sand to negotiate. The broad outside route leaves about 287 m and needs an extra shot.
The green extends the narrow balcony: a precise driver to the 229 m landing leaves about 215 m uphill. The broad opposite balcony leaves over 335 m: play a setup shot first.
Driver to the first cape at 230 m, then wood 3 for 202 m to the second: about 142 m remain. The broad opposite shelves allow four conservative shots before putting.
A long club can reach the green directly between lake and bunker. The broad short apron on the dry bank is an easier reception but leaves a chip of about 74 m.
Driver to the small 224 m landing between ridge and lake leaves about 187 m to the green. The broad opposite shelf leaves over 307 m and needs an extra setup shot.
Driver to the 220 m pocket, then wood 3 for 210 m to the final reception: about 128 m remain. The broad outside bank avoids both precise crossings but needs four shots before putting.
